name: Rev Deborah L Johnson
reason: Political-content rule (owner, 5 Nov 2026; brief: a channel carrying partisan political commentary). She is a New Thought minister (founder of Inner Light Ministries, Santa Cruz; own site revdnow.com, email info@revdnow.com), but her own YouTube channel @AskRevDNow, linked from her site, carries a run of partisan election videos alongside her spiritual talks, e.g. 'Kamala Harris is an Ally in LGBTQAI Inclusion', 'What you need to know about Tariffs & The Trump Tax', 'Why Mass Deportation Is Not The Answer…', 'My Thoughts on The Kamala Harris / Tim Walz Rally In Vegas', and her podcast describes its topics as 'personal to the political'. Skipped for the owner to decide; the Inner Light Ministries channel itself is mainly Sunday talks.
